/* Attd14Mapper.selectAdminRequestHistory */ SELECT R.CHANGE_REQ_ID AS changeReqId , R.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , R.SITE_CD AS siteCd , R.TARGET_USER_CD AS targetUserCd , TU.USER_NM AS targetUserNm , R.TARGET_LEAVE_ID AS targetLeaveId , LU.START_DATE AS targetStartDate , R.INITIATOR_TYPE AS initiatorType , R.REQ_TYPE AS reqType , R.MOVE_TARGET_DATE AS moveTargetDate , R.REQ_REASON AS reqReason , R.WORKER_RESPONSE AS workerResponse , R.RESPONSE_REASON AS responseReason , R.REJECT_REASON AS rejectReason , R.REQ_STATUS AS reqStatus , R.INITIATOR_USER_CD AS initiatorUserCd , IU.USER_NM AS initiatorUserNm , R.CONFIRM_USER_CD AS confirmUserCd , CU.USER_NM AS confirmUserNm , DATE_FORMAT(R.CONFIRM_DATE, '%Y%m%d%H%i%s') AS confirmDate , DATE_FORMAT(R.INSERT_DATE, '%Y%m%d%H%i%s') AS insertDate , R.MOVE_TARGET_HALF_PART AS moveTargetHalfPart , R.MOVE_TARGET_START_TIME AS moveTargetStartTime , LU.LEAVE_MINUTES AS leaveMinutes FROM TB_LEAVE_CHANGE_REQUEST R LEFT JOIN TB_USER TU ON TU.CMPNY_CD = R.CMPNY_CD AND TU.USER_CD = R.TARGET_USER_CD LEFT JOIN TB_USER IU ON IU.CMPNY_CD = R.CMPNY_CD AND IU.USER_CD = R.INITIATOR_USER_CD LEFT JOIN TB_USER CU ON CU.CMPNY_CD = R.CMPNY_CD AND CU.USER_CD = R.CONFIRM_USER_CD LEFT JOIN TB_USER_LEAVE_USE LU ON LU.CMPNY_CD = R.CMPNY_CD AND LU.LEAVE_ID = R.TARGET_LEAVE_ID
ORDER BY R.INSERT_DATE DESC, R.CHANGE_REQ_ID DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
/* Attd14Mapper.selectAdminRequestHistoryCount */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_LEAVE_CHANGE_REQUEST R LEFT JOIN TB_USER TU ON TU.CMPNY_CD = R.CMPNY_CD AND TU.USER_CD = R.TARGET_USER_CD

/* Attd14Mapper.selectAdminRequestHistoryDetail */ SELECT R.CHANGE_REQ_ID AS changeReqId , R.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , R.SITE_CD AS siteCd , R.TARGET_USER_CD AS targetUserCd , TU.USER_NM AS targetUserNm , R.TARGET_LEAVE_ID AS targetLeaveId , LU.START_DATE AS targetStartDate , R.INITIATOR_TYPE AS initiatorType , R.REQ_TYPE AS reqType , R.MOVE_TARGET_DATE AS moveTargetDate , R.REQ_REASON AS reqReason , R.WORKER_RESPONSE AS workerResponse , R.RESPONSE_REASON AS responseReason , R.REJECT_REASON AS rejectReason , R.REQ_STATUS AS reqStatus , R.INITIATOR_USER_CD AS initiatorUserCd , IU.USER_NM AS initiatorUserNm , R.CONFIRM_USER_CD AS confirmUserCd , CU.USER_NM AS confirmUserNm , DATE_FORMAT(R.CONFIRM_DATE, '%Y%m%d%H%i%s') AS confirmDate , DATE_FORMAT(R.INSERT_DATE, '%Y%m%d%H%i%s') AS insertDate , R.MOVE_TARGET_HALF_PART AS moveTargetHalfPart , R.MOVE_TARGET_START_TIME AS moveTargetStartTime , LU.LEAVE_MINUTES AS leaveMinutes FROM TB_LEAVE_CHANGE_REQUEST R LEFT JOIN TB_USER TU ON TU.CMPNY_CD = R.CMPNY_CD AND TU.USER_CD = R.TARGET_USER_CD LEFT JOIN TB_USER IU ON IU.CMPNY_CD = R.CMPNY_CD AND IU.USER_CD = R.INITIATOR_USER_CD LEFT JOIN TB_USER CU ON CU.CMPNY_CD = R.CMPNY_CD AND CU.USER_CD = R.CONFIRM_USER_CD LEFT JOIN TB_USER_LEAVE_USE LU ON LU.CMPNY_CD = R.CMPNY_CD AND LU.LEAVE_ID = R.TARGET_LEAVE_ID WHERE R.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND R.CHANGE_REQ_ID = #{changeReqId} AND R.INITIATOR_TYPE = 'ADMIN' AND R.DEL_YN = 'N' LIMIT 1
